column13: Directory (a power, not a duty); court may order up to 20% but must give reasons for the amount

column12: Whether a person who only signs a company's cheque is the 'drawer' who can be ordered to pay interim compensation under s 143A
column13: No. An authorised signatory is not the drawer; a 20% deposit under s 148 is also not compulsory in his appeal.
column14: N. Harihara Krishnan v. J. Thomas (Supreme Court) on who the 'drawer' is.
